Bihar Administrative Service Officials Transferred, New Assignments Revealed

The Bihar Administrative Service has transferred 36 officials, with new assignments being revealed. The move is part of the state government's administrative restructuring efforts. The transfers are expected to impact various departments and officials in the state. The reasons behind the transfers are not explicitly stated, but they are seen as a step towards improving governance and efficiency.
